tickerText: [TENNIS] Rolex Paris Masters semifinals Saturday at La Défense Arena: Shelton–Van Assche and Alcaraz–Ruud after Friday QF wins, with last Frenchman Van Assche chasing a first Masters 1000 final • [SQUASH] PSA Platinum U.S. Open finals Saturday at 6 p.m. ET in Philadelphia as Diego Elias meets Paul Coll after upsetting world No. 1 Mostafa Asal in the semis • [BADMINTON] Yeosu Korea Open Super 500 semifinals Saturday on Court 1 as An Se Young faces Hina Akechi after a 21-7, 21-13 QF sweep extended her 53-match win streak • [PICKLEBALL] Opendoor PPA Worlds pro semifinals Saturday from 11 a.m. CT at Brookhaven ahead of Championship Sunday finals • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT Champions Frankfurt Saturday quarterfinals at Süwag Energie Arena, with Lin Yun-Ju, Harimoto, Qiu Dang and home crowds on best-of-five tables

newsItems.title: An Semifinal Saturday
newsItems.excerpt: World No. 1 An Se Young beat Riko Gunji 21-7, 21-13 in 37 minutes and meets Hina Akechi in Yeosu semifinals as she chases a record-tying 11th title of 2026.

newsItems.title: Worlds Semifinal Day
newsItems.excerpt: Brookhaven hosts PPA Worlds pro semifinals Saturday from 11 a.m. CT as the 3,000-point major sets up Championship Sunday title matches across five divisions.

newsItems.title: Frankfurt Last Eight
newsItems.excerpt: WTT Champions Frankfurt opens Saturday quarterfinals on a single table at the Süwag Energie Arena as the season’s final Champions stop stakes Hong Kong Finals points.

newsItems.title: Paris Semi Saturday
newsItems.excerpt: Shelton–Van Assche and Alcaraz–Ruud headline Paris semifinals after Alcaraz saved two match points vs Fritz and Van Assche kept France’s last hope alive.
